title: Identity Assurance Level
description: The identity confidence held for an accountable human actor behind a certified release. Every certification level sets a minimum: L0 requires IAL2, L1–L2 require IAL3, and L3–L5 require IAL4. A wholly anonymous responsible party cannot hold a certified release. This schema is the published list; the permitted values are the oneOf under `id`.

oneOf.title: IAL1 — anonymous
oneOf.description: No reliable identity information. This level is not sufficient for PPA application certification.

oneOf.title: IAL2 — attested
oneOf.description: The person’s name and identity are confirmed by at least one already-identified person.

oneOf.title: IAL3 — passport-verified
oneOf.description: The person is verified against a passport or an equivalent high-confidence eID.

oneOf.title: IAL4 — passport and independent attestation
oneOf.description: IAL3 plus confirmation of the person’s identity by at least three passport-identified people.
